results.title: Refunds by payment method › Card
results.text:
Card refunds go back to the card you paid with and arrive in 5–7 business days
after we send them. Your bank may show the refund as a credit on your next
statement.

results.title: Refunds by payment method › Wallet
results.text:
Wallet refunds go back to the same wallet and arrive in 1–3 business days after
we send them.

results.title: Refund timing › How long until the refund reaches you
results.text:
After we send the refund, it reaches you in:
- UPI: 1–3 business days
- Wallet: 1–3 business days
- Card: 5–7 business days
- Cash on delivery: 5–7 business days by bank transfer, counted from the day
  you add your bank details

Business days are Monday to Friday.
